# sequentialist-clinical

> Application software for interim monitoring of two-arm clinical trials: declared designs, analyses at data cut-offs, committee reports and an audit trail. Treatment selection is not implemented.

## Start here

- [Plain-language overview and FAQ](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/docs/overview.md): intended users, inputs, outputs, workflow and limits.
- [Обзор и ответы на вопросы на русском](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/docs/overview.ru.md): назначение, входные данные, отчёты, рабочий процесс и ограничения.
- [README](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/README.md): endpoint support, design and analysis examples.
- [Package metadata](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/pyproject.toml): distribution name, dependencies and Python support.

## Implementation and verification

- [Trial execution](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/src/sequentialist/clinical/trial.py): cut-off analysis, recommendations and decisions.
- [ADaM import](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/src/sequentialist/clinical/adam.py): supported source formats and variables.
- [Tests](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/tree/main/tests): implementation checks and committed reference values.
- [Interim monitoring example](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/examples/interim_monitoring.py): synthetic time-to-event trial.

- [Agent guidance](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/AGENTS.md): code map and validation commands.

- [Commercial terms](https://github.com/andre-a-no/sequentialist-clinical/blob/main/COMMERCIAL.md): commercial licensing information.
